scope: Current HTML-only refresh using updated Aha guidance and retained sealed research.

anc.explanation: Names the two pressure contributions, their amplitude and opposite signs at the ear, the timing-error connection to frequency, and remaining speech cues. Removes vague matching language and disconnected outline fragments.
anc.boundary: The phase slider is an ideal single-tone, equal-amplitude, one-point pressure model. It is not measured attenuation, dB, perceived loudness or product advice.

git-merge.explanation: The title names Git merge and a reverted change without unexplained example values. The lead introduces the timeout configuration field before 30 and 60, then describes the change, revert and merge result. Both current snapshots are explained relative to the shared base. The recorded clean merge or unresolved working file appears with the corresponding graph, HEAD and index state.
git-merge.boundary: Inspected source v2.49.0 and recorded Git 2.53.0.windows.4 are distinct. Cases display saved observations, not live simulation. Textual success does not establish application correctness.

languageReview.method: Each author independently read the complete English and Chinese text, then compared their facts and conditions; the parent read both source documents and refined the introductions and terminology.
languageReview.coverage: Headlines, prose, diagram labels, controls, dynamic feedback, sources and limitations. After user feedback about the unexplained 60, both Git headlines, browser titles, lead paragraphs and revert captions were revised together, along with the gallery and README entry.
languageReview.status: Agent editorial judgment, not independent human translation acceptance or a measured improvement in learner comprehension.

visualReview.sample: Representative light-theme openings and diagrams were sampled during the initial refresh. After the contextual headline revision, the final Chinese Git mobile opening screenshot was viewed again: the full question fits two lines and the configuration field precedes its values. Current captures are in screenshots/.
visualReview.revision: Replaced the context-free 60 headline with a named Git merge question and adjusted narrow-screen Chinese heading size to preserve the full context within two lines at 390px.
visualReview.fontObservation: Browser platform-font inspection of the Chinese ANC introduction reported Microsoft YaHei fallback under the required system-font stack.
visualReview.limits: Sampled inspection is not exhaustive visual acceptance of every state. The final mobile heading also passes geometry checks in both themes; screenshot files alone do not establish human review.

runtimeReview.method: Explicit user-approved local execution after source review, isolated Edge context, offline mode, blocked service workers and external requests.
runtimeReview.coverage: Two languages, two themes, 1280px and 390px widths, keyboard interactions, model endpoints/reset, all recorded Git cases and file contents, HEAD/index state, localization, document overflow, SVG text bounds, console errors, gallery and receipt identities. Git-specific regression checks verify named title subjects, matching browser/visible titles, and timeout introduced before example values.
runtimeReview.resultAuthority: Read the current runtime.json for exact counts and failures; it is regenerated by check-html.mjs.
runtimeReview.packaging: Both final projects passed explain-check. Packaging and receipts establish structural provenance, not semantic truth.

attribution: Updated Aha guidance plus the host web-artifacts-builder Clawpilot palette and system fonts. Original inline diagrams and no downloaded assets. This is not an Aha-only aesthetic comparison.
cleanup: Removed old media outputs, old format projects, archives, historical evaluations and stale static QA. Kept sealed research, editable HTML, required project research copies, useful source-stage author reviews, valid Git evidence and only current evaluation evidence.
